reply.text: Electrolytes can be useful in some situations, mostly long or very sweaty sessions, hot conditions, or hard efforts running past an hour or so. For most lifting sessions and normal days, water and regular meals cover it. I can't give you an amount of sodium, though. That depends on your sweat, your diet and your health, so a doctor or a registered dietitian is the right person to set a number for you. If you tell me what kind of training has you asking, I can speak to that side of it.
